fusions.name: Split Cast
fusions.desc: Throws your mesh so it splits in two, the halves flying apart; each deals 11 damage to the first enemy it meets and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Prong Through the Knot
fusions.desc: Drives a two-tined gaff through your mesh and into the target, dealing 32 damage that ignores armour, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds and [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Back Along the Cords
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to branch back along your mesh to whoever laid it instead.

fusions.name: Branching Strand
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your mesh forks off a second strand that hits the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
